GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   D. Treat Weather as rumours only.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   B. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

7. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   B. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   D. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

10. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   D. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   B. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   D. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   B. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   D. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   C. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.

14. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   B. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

15. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
